controls.cited_for: that patently insubstantial claims must be flimsier than doubtful or questionable — they must be essentially fictitious
controls.court_quote: This standard “demands that the claims be flimsier than ‘doubtful or questionable’— they must be ‘essentially fictitious.’” Best v. Kelly, 39 F.3d 328, 330 (D.C. Cir. 1994) (quoting Hagans v. Lavine, 415 U.S. 528, 536–37 (1974)).
controls.quote_locator: slip op. (Part on patently insubstantial claims)
